primaryWitnesses.text: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.

primaryWitnesses.text: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.

primaryWitnesses.text: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much plunder.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文にこの場所名/対応地形が明記されます。前後文脈を読み、用例が集団・人名ではないことを確認しました。
ここでの「セイルの子ら」はアマツヤに打たれた人々を表す集団表現で、山地名を指す用例ではありません。
「セイルの子ら」の神々は民族・集団を表し、地理的な山地としては扱いません。
